ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, HM Treasury sanctions list, Interpol notices, and the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit's domestic AML/CFT risk indicators. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates; source of wealth and source of funds must be documented. Adverse media and negative news screening is required. The registered agent must retain CDD and risk-assessment records for at least five years after the termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands — Corporate Registry (Majuro); filings submitted through licensed RMI Registered Agents.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in English or in a Latin-script representation. Non-Latin script names must be transliterated into English or Marshallese for the certificate of incorporation. Names must be distinguishable from existing registered names and must not suggest a connection with the Republic of the Marshall Islands, the U.S. government, or any international governmental organization.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name clearance is refused, the applicant or its registered agent may file a written request for reconsideration with the Registrar within 21 days of refusal, stating the grounds and supplying supporting documents such as written consents from existing name holders. The Registrar must respond in writing within 14 days. A second refusal may be appealed to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands within 30 days of the reconsideration decision. A name reservation may be renewed for an additional 30 days only if the renewal request is filed before the initial reservation expires and the prescribed renewal fee is paid.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for statutory purposes: the registered agent's address may be used as the registered office in Marshall Islands. No physical business premises, employees, or residency in the Marshall Islands is required for a non-resident exempt Business Corporation, unless the entity later establishes actual operations, imports regulated dental devices, or opens a local place of business in RMI territory.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated below 1% per entity-year for non-resident exempt corporations, with unannounced inspections generally reserved for cases involving AML/CFT red flags, complaints, or suspected misuse of the corporate form.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (ss.22–27 Articles of Incorporation; ss.28–31 Registered Office and Registered Agent; ss.33–37 Directors and Officers); Foreign Investment Business License Act 1997 (ss.5–9)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registry Division, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Certificate of Incorporation) on Form BCA-1, together with the Registered Agent's Consent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; shares may be issued for such consideration as the Board determines sufficient; no escrow or deposit account requirement under RMI law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts subscriptions for 1,000 common shares at US$0.01 per share, confirms receipt of consideration, and authorizes issuance of share certificates; RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation at the address of its licensed Registered Agent in Majuro, Marshall Islands, is adopted as the Corporation's principal office; RESOLVED, that [Name], [Name], and [Name] are appointed President, Secretary, and Treasurer, respectively, each to serve until the annual shareholders' meeting; RESOLVED, that the President is authorized to file all statutory licenses, open bank accounts, and execute documents incidental to the lawful commencement of business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registry Division, Office of the Attorney General, with a licensed RMI Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request to the Registry through the appointed Registered Agent. The Registry screens the proposed name for distinction and prohibition under Business Corporations Act s.23. Upon clearance, the name is reserved for three months with one renewal period.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent Engagement Letter and Consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as indistinguishable from an existing corporate name, file an alternative name application or request administrative review of the examiner's finding within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public (Marshall Islands or recognized foreign notary) together with the Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Each subscriber executes the Articles of Incorporation, declaring the corporate purpose limited to the thermoforming and automated trimming of multilayer dental clear aligner sheets, authorized shares, initial directors, and the Majuro registered office. Execution must be witnessed and notarially acknowledged.
required_dossiers: Corporate purpose statement referencing ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339114
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct signature or acknowledgment defects by executing a revised acknowledgment page; the full notarized package is resubmitted to the Registered Agent within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registry Division, Office of the Attorney General
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent files the notarized Articles, consents, and US$275 official fee. The Registrar verifies compliance and issues the Certificate of Incorporation; expedited processing is available for one-business-day issuance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried by deficiency notice, the applicant has ten business days to cure defects; failure to cure results in rejection, after which a corrected package may be re-filed with the Registrar's written instructions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of First Board Resolution and Organizational Minutes
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Business Corporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Board convenes and adopts the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution covering share subscription and issuance, adoption of the registered office, and appointment of officers. The secretary records the minutes, opens the share register, and issues share certificates.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any omitted item may be ratified by a unanimous written consent of the full Board executed in lieu of a physical meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License and Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business License Office, Ministry of Finance, with the Foreign Investment Business License Board
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual Business License application and, because the entity is non-resident-owned, a concurrent FIBL application describing the proposed industrial activity: thermoforming and trimming of multilayer PETG/TPU dental aligner sheets. Pay the annual license fee based on the applicable revenue band.
required_dossiers: Business plan describing manufacturing scope and premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: License denial may be appealed in writing to the Minister of Finance within 30 days; alternatively, material amendments to the application may be re-filed without prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Registration and Civil Defense / Fire Safety Inspection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA) and Majuro Fire and Safety Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the EPA Minor-Impact Registration for the light thermoforming facility, documenting HVAC exhaust filtration, waste segregation of polymer scrap, and use of non-toxic medical-grade resins. Obtain the Fire Safety Certificate and structural clearance for the facility prior to equipment commissioning.
required_dossiers: Facility floor plan and waste matrix
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EPA assigns a higher classification, submit a full Environmental Compliance Statement; fire safety deficiencies trigger a 30-day corrective directive and re-inspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: RMI Business License Office, Ministry of Finance; Foreign Investment Business License Board
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) and Standard Business License (Light Manufacturing Category) for thermoforming and automated trimming of dental clear aligner sheets

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III (Registration) – Minor-Impact Light Manufacturing; Full EIA Report required if annual thermoplastic throughput exceeds 50 metric tonnes or if the facility adjoins sensitive coastal zones.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source process water discharge; process cooling water recycled; sanitary discharge to RMI EPA-approved sewer at pH 6.0–9.0 and BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L; VOC emissions limited to less than 10 mg/m³ from any solvent cleaning operation; all PETG/TPU scrap, trimmings, and offcuts segregated, labeled, and manifested to EPA-approved recyclers or landfill under the RMI Solid Waste Regulations 1998.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Majuro Fire and Safety Division after annual inspection of egress, extinguishers, and suppression systems; structural load inspection under the RMI Building Code 1998 for placement of thermoforming presses and automated trimmers; occupational clearance verifying machine guarding, noise controls, ventilation, and PPE compliance under the RMI Labor Regulations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Taxation Office, Ministry of Finance (administers direct tax and social security); Customs and Excise Division, Ministry of Finance (administers indirect tax/import duty). Public portal: https://rmigovernment.org (official government e-services portal).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no national income tax, VAT, or sales tax. A non-resident Business Corporation is not required to obtain a TIN or VAT ID. If the entity transacts locally or employs individuals, it must register with the RMI Social Security Administration for an employer registration number. For physical importation or export of goods, the entity must register with the RMI Customs and Excise Division for a Customs Client/Importer ID (RMI-CID) and obtain a business license from the Registrar of Corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Non-resident Business Corporations incorporated under the RMI Business Corporations Act (BCCA) that conduct no business within the Republic and derive no income from RMI sources are statutorily exempt from any future national income tax. There is no check-the-box regime and no hybrid mismatch election, as the RMI currently levies no corporate income tax. The BCCA permits an election to register as a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation, which triggers a conclusive presumption of foreign-source status for all corporate income and transactions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Import Duty and Excise Duty (Customs and Excise Act 2018); no VAT, no GST, and no sales and use tax exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. The RMI operates no VAT or GST and therefore imposes no registration threshold. Import duty arises transactionally on actual physical importation into the RMI; no economic turnover threshold triggers an indirect tax registration. A Customs Client/Importer ID is required only for clearance purposes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The RMI has no electronic invoicing mandate, no real-time fiscal clearance requirement, no certified fiscal data controller, and no digital stamping or API-based tax clearance gateway. Paper-based customs declarations are submitted via the Pacific Islands Trade and Customs (PITAC) portal primarily for statistical and duty-assessment purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: In the absence of VAT/GST, export zero-rating is inapplicable as a concept. Goods exported from the RMI are not subject to export duty. Goods manufactured in the RMI and shipped abroad qualify for a duty-free export regime, and imported raw materials subsequently re-exported in an unused state or incorporated into an exported product may qualify for a customs duty drawback or temporary importation relief under Customs and Excise Act 2018. For a non-resident Business Corporation operating wholly offshore, domestic sales nexus is absent and no indirect tax liability attaches to export proceeds.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (customs form EX-1, filed through PITAC)
Bill of Lading (Ocean) or Air Waybill (Air)
Inward Remittance Certificate / Bank Credit Advice (evidencing receipt of export sale proceeds from the overseas buyer, required for duty drawback and for foreign-exchange record purposes)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False export declarations, diversion of duty-free or drawback-qualified goods into domestic consumption, and fraudulent claims of export relief are prosecuted under the Customs and Excise Act 2018. Penalties include fines of up to USD 10,000 per offence, forfeiture of goods, and retrospective clawback of any duty refund or drawback paid, increased by a 50% penalty surcharge. Repeated or collusive violations may also result in denial of future customs clearances and suspension of the entity's Customs Client/Importer ID.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Not applicable — the Republic of the Marshall Islands has no central bank and no foreign-exchange administration. The U.S. dollar is legal tender, and banking supervision is exercised by the Marshall Islands Banking Commission.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMI is a dollarized economy with fully unrestricted currency convertibility for both current-account and capital-account transactions. There are no foreign-exchange permits, approvals, or restrictions on inward or outward payments. Current-account payments, including trade settlements, service fees, royalties, and profit remittances, may be made freely in USD. Capital-account transactions, including equity subscriptions, shareholder loans, debt repayments, and liquidation distributions, are likewise unrestricted. Profit remittances by a Non-Resident Business Corporation are not subject to RMI statutory withholding or foreign-exchange clearance; the only practical hurdles are the remitting bank's AML source-of-funds review, OFAC/sanctions screening, and destination-country tax treatment.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The RMI imposes no statutory surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation or holding-period requirement for export proceeds. Export receivables may be retained in USD or foreign currency in any bank account, onshore or offshore, and may be freely converted, invested, or hedged without central bank or Banking Commission approval.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Development Loan Facility (not a commercial treasury account)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium structured viability. The RMI has no electronic-money-institution licensing framework, and offshore digital EMIs are not supervised by the Marshall Islands Banking Commission. Offshore EMIs cannot open local RMI accounts and are not authorized banking counterparties for the RMI entity. They may be used only as third-party payment processors or card-acquiring gateways, not as local bank substitutes. For the target payment rails of Platform_Credit_Card and Stripe, the compliant structure is a U.S.-domiciled merchant acquiring account settled through SWIFT or Fedwire into the RMI corporate operational account, with a contractual liability cascade covering card chargebacks, sanctions, and KYC obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person interview is effectively mandatory for first-time non-resident clients. At least one director, senior officer, or authorized signatory must appear in person at a Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam branch in Majuro or Ebeye, unless the RMI bank agrees to rely on a formal introduced-by attestation from a recognized foreign correspondent bank. Fully remote onboarding is generally unavailable for a Non-Resident Business Corporation with no RMI operational nexus. The KYC interview will cover beneficial ownership, source of funds, intended transaction flows, and the real economic activity of the dental clear-aligner manufacturing and export operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-Resident Business Corporation classified as a shell entity because it has no employees, lease, or operational footprint inside the Marshall Islands.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current certificate of incorporation and good standing; registered-agent attestation; notarized board resolution opening the account; audited or management financial statements; commercial lease and utility evidence for the physical production facility; payroll and staffing records; inventory and supplier invoices; customer purchase orders; and a written economic-substance memorandum explaining the real activities underlying the RMI vehicle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owners reside wholly outside the RMI with a multi-tier or opaque equity structure and insufficient source-of-funds evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed UBO declaration covering all owners with 25% or greater interest; certified passport copies; independent negative-media, PEP, and sanctions screening reports; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds memoranda; ownership cascade with corporate registry extracts for each intermediate entity; confirmation that no undisclosed trusts or nominee arrangements exist; and a written undertaking to report any UBO change within 14 days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export trade red flag: dental aligner sheet sales are routed through platform credit-card and Stripe channels, creating chargeback exposure and an attenuated banking trail.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISO 13485:2016 quality-management certificate; medical device registration or CE/FDA/TGA conformity documentation for the aligner sheets; commercial invoices, packing lists, and bills of lading; end-customer purchase agreements; documented refund, return, and chargeback policy; processor agreements with Stripe or the acquiring bank; PCI DSS attestation of compliance; and product-liability insurance certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume inbound capital injections without demonstrated economic purpose may be flagged as layering or trade-money-laundering risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital subscription agreements; board resolutions approving each equity or debt injection; bank reference letters from the remitting institution; shareholder financial statements or audited accounts; a group cash-flow and funding explanation; a breakdown between equity, shareholder loans, and trade advances; and payment scheduling that is consistent with the business plan and documented trade cycle.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity must be routed as a clean USD SWIFT MT103 from the named shareholder's own bank account directly to the RMI Business Corporation operational account. No cash, cryptocurrency, or third-party off-account transfers are permitted. The RMI has no exchange-control permission or notification requirement, but the bank will apply OFAC screening, UBO authentication, and source-of-funds review. Recommended MT103 fields: field 50K or 52D must disclose the remitting shareholder; field 59 must show the BC's exact account name and number; field 70 must state Capital Subscription - Equity Contribution, together with the board-resolution and subscription reference. If clearing through a U.S. correspondent bank, the Fedwire message must match the SWIFT beneficiary details and comply with OFAC and U.S. reporting requirements. For transfers above USD 25,000, the RMI bank may require a board resolution, subscription agreement, and source-of-funds memorandum.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements should use SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier disbursements and MT202 COV for correspondent reimbursement when a letter of credit is established. Raw-material purchases, including PETG/TPU clear-aligner sheet stock and packaging, should be supported by an irrevocable commercial letter of credit issued under UCP600 and advised or confirmed through the beneficiary's bank, with reimbursement claims following URR725. Card-originated sales are settled by Stripe or platform acquiring into a U.S. settlement account and thereafter swept by ACH, Fedwire, or SWIFT MT103 to the RMI operating account. No cash letters, unnamed third-party payments, or open-account netting against intracompany balances should be used; every disbursement must retain a clear reconciliation to the underlying invoice and shipping documents.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/EUR plain-vanilla outright forward executed offshore under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement
USD/JPY deliverable foreign-exchange swap with a licensed international bank counterparty
USD/CNY non-deliverable forward (NDF) for emerging-market Renminbi exposure
USD/AUD cross-currency swap with credit support annex, used only to hedge committed receivables or payables

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of Domestic Corporation and payment of annual report fee (Business Corporations Act, ss. 144-146). Confirms current members, directors, resident agent, registered office and authorized share capital.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (submitted through the licensed resident agent in Majuro)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the last day of the incorporation anniversary month; the official due date is driven by the anniversary date of the Certificate of Incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The unpaid annual fee accrues statutory late penalties; following formal notice, the Registrar publishes the delinquency in the RMI Official Gazette and may administratively revoke or strike off the charter if not remedied within approximately 90 days. Reinstatement requires settlement of all arrears, penalties and a restoration fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Resident Agent and Registered Office Annual Renewal (MBCA ss. 103-106). Non-resident Business Corporation must continuously maintain a licensed resident agent and physical registered office in Majuro.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Resident Agent / Registered Office Provider, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the Annual Report, in the incorporation anniversary month, prior to the next renewal year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to renew causes the resident agent to resign; the Registrar is notified, and the corporation has a limited statutory period to appoint a replacement before administrative revocation of the charter.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership / Know-Your-Customer Confirmation (non-public RMI BO compliance).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Resident Agent's compliance record (subject to lawful inspection by RMI Registrar or Financial Intelligence Unit; no public UBO registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each annual renewal and within 15 days after any change in control, share transfer, or beneficial ownership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-confirmation prevents the agent from certifying the corporation's compliance; continued non-response may lead the agent to terminate representation, triggering charter revocation risk. Such failures may also constitute AML/CFT non-compliance subject to regulatory enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Register Review and Reconciliation (register audit by the resident agent).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate records maintained at the registered office in Majuro (internal verification, not a public filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Before submission of each Annual Report; completed as part of the anniversary renewal cycle.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unreconciled registers may invalidate the agent's certification of issued share capital; unresolved discrepancies may expose directors to inaccuracy liability in the filed annual report and delay the issuance of certificates of good standing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None under Marshall Islands law. The MBCA imposes no mandatory independent audit for non-resident Business Corporations based on revenue, assets, employees, or shareholder count. A certified audit becomes contractually compulsory only when imposed by a financing lender, insurer, US FDA/ISO certification body, foreign distributor/regulator, or an investor agreement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The RMI does not prescribe a national accounting standard for non-resident exempt corporations. Financial statements are customarily prepared in accordance with IFRS or, where required by US counterparties, US GAAP. RMI taxation applies only to locally sourced income; a non-resident BC transacting exclusively outside the RMI is not subject to RMI income tax or gross revenue tax and files no RMI income tax return beyond its annual report fee.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: RMI maintains no public UBO register. At onboarding and on every future share transfer, the licensed resident agent obtains, verifies, and retains certified identification and structure evidence for each natural-person beneficial owner and relevant officer. During the annual renewal cycle, the agent obtains an annual written confirmation attesting there has been no change in control, and refreshes underlying documentation where any transfer occurred. The BO records must be available for lawful demand by the RMI Registrar of Corporations or the Financial Intelligence Unit.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 - USD 1,500 per annum (resident agent, registered office, and renewal filing service excluding government fee)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 20,000 - USD 45,000 per engagement (voluntary IFRS/US GAAP audit, only when required by lender, investor, or overseas regulator)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation tax-exempt zone under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act and Income Tax Act 1989: complete exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, payroll tax, and VAT/GST on all foreign-source income. The only recurring fiscal obligations are the annual report filing and the statutory franchise fee (USD 250 minimum base tier, escalating by authorized share tiers).
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_explanation: Carryforward rules are inapplicable because a non-resident Business Corporation has no Marshall Islands-source taxable income and no recognized tax loss base; no loss utilization, expiration, or carryback mechanism is triggered under RMI law.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report Form (Business Corporation) filed through the Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations e-filing portal, submitted exclusively by a licensed RMI Registered Agent; no income tax return is required for non-resident domestic corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (once per calendar year, on each anniversary of incorporation)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the last day of the month in which the corporation's incorporation anniversary falls, per BCCA Section 102; no fiscal-year-end income-tax deadline applies because no income tax return exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered name of the Business Corporation as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation, including any corporate suffix (BC/Corp/Inc).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name exactly as registered in the RMI corporate registry; a non-resident BC may use the same name in foreign dental aligner markets without any RMI trade-name registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and RMI street address of the licensed registered agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory even for non-resident BCs; the agent must hold a valid RMI license and maintain the registered office; the agent will countersign and transmit the annual report.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in the Marshall Islands (not a post office box).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Typically identical to the registered agent's address in Majuro or Ebeye; must be a genuine RMI physical location for service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Indication of whether the corporation is a Resident Domestic or Non-Resident Domestic corporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mark Non-Resident Domestic Corporation; this status is the statutory basis for full tax exemption and requires that the corporation conducts no business within the Republic and has no resident directors.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of all directors and officers; minimum one director for a Business Corporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors need not be RMI residents or citizens and may be corporate bodies; provide full legal names and foreign addresses; beneficial ownership detail is captured separately for AML purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value or no-par-value designation, and class structure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The annual franchise fee is computed from this entry (e.g., USD 250 for up to 5,000 shares, escalating to USD 500 and beyond); capital is not required to be paid up.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification signed by a director or officer confirming that the corporation does not carry on business, trade, or conduct activities within the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This declaration is the operative certification for the tax-exempt zone; false certification triggers criminal and civil liability for the signing director.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8: Annual Report Fee Schedule and Payment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed annual franchise/report fee based on authorized share tier, payable to the Registrar of Corporations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident BCs pay the reduced non-resident tier (base USD 250); payment must be remitted through the registered agent with the e-filed annual report.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of USD 200 for an annual report submitted after the last day of the anniversary month; an additional USD 400 delinquency penalty applies after six months of non-filing. Continued delinquency triggers administrative dissolution and strike-off by the Registrar, with reinstatement conditioned on full payment of arrears, penalties, and reinstatement fees.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividend distributions by a Business Corporation, whether paid to RMI residents, non-residents, or foreign corporate shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Marshall Islands maintains no comprehensive double tax treaty network; therefore, no treaty relief application or Tax Residency Certificate protocol is available or required. The zero-withholding outcome is achieved statutorily by maintaining valid Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status; a certified copy of the filed annual report declaration and the Certificate of Incorporation serve as the documentary evidence for withholding relief in cross-border payment chains.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on cross-border royalty payments and debt interest; no treaty rates apply because no DTA network exists. Caution: royalty income sourced from intellectual property may nonetheless attract Economic Substance Regulations review if the IP holding function is carried on by the BC; such income is federally tax-exempt but requires substance compliance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer-pricing documentation threshold, Local File, or Master File obligation exists in Marshall Islands law, and the functional currency is USD. Nevertheless, if the BC engages in cross-border related-party transactions (e.g., purchasing multilayer PETG/TPU aligner sheet inputs from an affiliate, or receiving distribution fees from a foreign parent), the entity should retain pricing analyses, intercompany agreements, and functional/risk documentation to substantiate arm's-length outcomes under general anti-avoidance principles and the ESR substance review.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations 2020. A non-resident BC is exempt from income tax but must satisfy substance tests if it carries on a relevant activity: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, pure holding company, distribution and service center, or intellectual property holding. The thermoforming and automated trimming of dental clear aligner sheets (ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339114) is not itself a listed relevant activity, but any separately conducted distribution, financing, or IP-holding functions are in scope and require adequate physical presence, qualified employees, and locally directed expenditure plus annual ESR reporting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Non-Resident Certification
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly certifying Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status on the annual report while actually carrying on business, maintaining a physical office, employing staff, or generating revenue inside the Marshall Islands, or understating authorized shares to reduce franchise fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of tax-exempt zone status; retroactive assessment of any applicable RMI-source taxes, interest, and penalties; criminal fines up to USD 5,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years for false statements under the Income Tax Act 1989 and RMI Criminal Code; administrative dissolution by the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign a false declaration are personally liable for civil restitution of avoided fees and taxes; courts may pierce the corporate veil, impose director disqualification orders, and issue travel bans pending criminal proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a letterbox Business Corporation solely to route dental aligner platform sales and retain the tax-exempt zone benefit while conducting no substantive business activity, carrying no employees, using a nominee agent address, and failing to file ESR returns for any relevant activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Economic Substance Regulations: monetary penalties up to USD 10,000 for non-filing or false filing, an additional penalty equal to the avoided tax benefit where relevant activity is established, deregistration of the entity, and prohibition of the registered agent from continuing to represent the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly cause the substance failure are jointly and severally liable for ESR penalties and enforcement costs; travel restrictions, director debarment, and asset freezing orders may be imposed by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and courts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting high-volume Stripe and platform credit-card payments for clear aligners without customer due diligence, beneficial-ownership identification, transaction monitoring, or suspicious-transaction reporting; using the MH BC as an opaque payment intermediary for third-party merchants.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the RMI Banking Act, Crimes (Amendment) Act, and AML/CFT framework: criminal money-laundering fines, forfeiture of proceeds, freezing orders, revocation of the entity's right to operate payment rails, and debarment from international correspondent banking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers with knowledge or reckless disregard face personal criminal prosecution, civil forfeiture of benefits, travel bans, and imprisonment; the corporate veil will be pierced where the BC is used as an instrumentality of money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Report and Chain Deregistration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Missing the annual report anniversary deadline for two consecutive years or failing to pay the franchise fee, resulting in administrative dissolution while the BC continues to trade and accept aligner-sales revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late penalty of USD 200 (increased by USD 400 after six months), administrative dissolution by the Registrar, automatic loss of legal capacity, and inability to sue, enforce contracts, or hold assets in RMI courts; reinstatement requires arrears, penalties, and reinstatement fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors remain fiduciaries during delinquency and are jointly and severally liable for debts and contractual obligations incurred after the entity's apparent dissolution; foreign directors may face personal service of process and asset attachment in cooperating jurisdictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Medical Device Manufacturing and Misrepresentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manufacturing or supplying thermoformed multilayer dental clear aligner sheets without the statutory health/medical device license required for ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339114 activity, or misrepresenting device classification to payment processors, customs authorities, or clinical customers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of statutory license, product seizure and recall, injunctive relief, fines under RMI public health and consumer protection statutes, and exclusion of the entity from the RMI corporate registry if the unlicensed activity is combined with false annual declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers are personally liable for consumer harm, defective product claims, and fraudulent misrepresentation; criminal prosecution, civil restitution, and director disqualification may follow where the Board knowingly authorized unlicensed production or deceptive payment-rail declarations.
